title: Curcumin inhibits HIV-1 by modulating FOXP3 and suppressing CCR5 via PI3K/AKT and JAK/STAT pathways.
authors: Shi, Mengyuan; Li, Qing; Zheng, Wenjin; Li, Qingya; Jiang, Min; Zhang, Jingyi; Wang, Zhe; Qiao, Lu; Feng, Long
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素通过PI3K/AKT和JAK/STAT通路抑制HIV-1，涉及FOXP3与CCR5启动子的结合及分子对接，虽含蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但核心是药物机制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Despite advances in antiretroviral therapy, HIV-1 persistence and immune dysregulation remain unresolved challenges. Here, we demonstrate that curcumin, a low-toxicity natural compound, can inhibit HIV-1 through simultaneous inhibition of the PI3K/AKT and JAK/STAT pathways, leading to downregulation of the viral co-receptor CCR5 and the immune checkpoint transcription factor FOXP3. Using CHIP and EMSA experiments, we found that curcumin disrupts the binding of FOXP3 to the CCR5 promoter, thereby reducing viral entry. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified STAT3 and AKT1 as key targets. Most importantly, we found that crosstalk between the PI3K/AKT and JAK/STAT pathways is a pharmacological axis for HIV-1 treatment through high-throughput sequencing technology, mass spectrometry and CO-IP experiments. Our findings provide a mechanistic basis for the repurposing of curcumin as an adjuvant to HAART, with implications for therapies targeting viral reservoirs.
abstract_zh: 尽管抗逆转录病毒治疗取得了进展，但HIV-1的持续存在和免疫失调仍是未解决的挑战。在此，我们证明姜黄素（curcumin），一种低毒性的天然化合物，能够通过同时抑制PI3K/AKT和JAK/STAT通路来抑制HIV-1，导致病毒共受体CCR5和免疫检查点转录因子FOXP3的下调。利用CHIP和EMSA实验，我们发现姜黄素破坏了FOXP3与CCR5启动子的结合，从而减少了病毒进入。网络药理学和分子对接（molecular docking）确定了STAT3和AKT1为关键靶点。最重要的是，通过高通量测序技术、质谱（mass spectrometry）和CO-IP实验，我们发现PI3K/AKT与JAK/STAT通路之间的串扰是HIV-1治疗的药理学轴心。我们的发现为姜黄素作为HAART辅助疗法的再利用提供了机制基础，并对靶向病毒储库的治疗具有启示意义。
